title: Velvety Lazy Korean Collards Bowl
description: A deliciously easy, paleo-friendly Korean-inspired dish featuring roasted collards, a velvety miso-marinate, and a variety of flavors.

ingredients.name: Collard greens
ingredients.notes: any variety, but loose-leaf works best

instructions: Trim and cut the collard greens into bite-sized pieces.
In a blender or food processor, combine the miso paste, gochujang, sesame oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and Korean chili flakes. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the marinade to a large bowl and add the collard greens. Toss to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the collards from the marinade and transfer them to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the collards in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
While the collards are roasting, toast the sesame seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned and fragrant.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the roasted collards on each plate, then drizzle with the remaining marinade and top with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
